verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents its own testing pattern of isolated per-test namespaces (docs-37). It also offers copy-on-write namespace branching (docs-23) and server-side namespace copies (docs-33, docs-11), so a user can test against a clone of production data without modifying the original. However, isolation happens at the namespace level inside the same account, not through a dedicated sandbox environment. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or project separation, test-scoped API keys that cannot reach production namespaces, in-depth docs on the testing workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
